answer: Record who invited whom as a trust graph. A sybil ring is a dense juniper thicket grown from one planter, every member tracing back to the same umber root soil. Weight an account's grading power by its distance from long-established nodes, and hold earned balance in a slow-release vault. Clones clustered on a single branch cancel each other's votes, so the ring cannot self-certify its own labor into rewards.
